name: Kuzhalappam
steps: Grind coconut, shallots, garlic and cumin with part of the measured water; strain to obtain a strongly flavoured liquid.
Bring that liquid and remaining water to a simmer with salt. Turn off heat and stir in rice flour and sesame to make a soft, non-sticky dough.
Cover until warm, then knead smooth. Roll small portions between oiled sheets into thin circles.
Wrap each disc around an oiled narrow handle or tube and seal the overlap with water; slide off gently, keeping the hollow centre open.
Fry the tubes in medium-hot coconut oil until lightly golden and crisp throughout. Drain, cool completely and store airtight.
tips: A stiff or dry dough cracks while rolling; knead in a few drops of warm water if needed.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
